preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array must be between 2 and 100000.
The number of elements that can be changed must be between 0 and the minimum of 10 and N-2.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be the resulting array as a space-separated string.
The resulting array must have the same length as the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] == result[0] + i * d for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The resulting array must form an arithmetic progression defined by the first element and the step.
